definitions.gloss: monthly period; month (for accounting or reporting)
definitions.explanation: A month-long period used as a unit for accounting, reporting, or business planning. Often the fiscal month does not align with the calendar month.

examples.japanese: {今月度|こんげつど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked this month's sales figures.

examples.japanese: {月度|げつど}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The monthly report is submitted at the end of each month.

examples.japanese: {前月度|ぜんげつど}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Profits increased compared to the previous month.

notes:
USAGE:
A business and accounting term. The {月度|げつど} period may not correspond exactly to a calendar month; companies often define their own fiscal month boundaries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月度|げつど}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧ (monthly report)
- {月度|げつど}⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧ (monthly budget)
- {今月度|こんげつど} (this month's period)
- {前月度|ぜんげつど} (previous month's period)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年度|ねんど}→年度：00309_nendo⟧: fiscal year — the yearly equivalent of {月度|げつど}
- ⟦{四半期|しはんき}→四半期：10103_shihanki⟧: quarter — a three-month period
